mcqs.question: The Sacred Herbal Garden proposed by TTD in Tirumala will be established over an area of how many acres near the GNC Toll Gate?
options: 3 acres
4 acres
5 acres
6 acres
mcqs.explanation: The garden will cover 4 acres between the lower and upper ghat roads, near the GNC Toll Gate. The tempting alternatives of 3, 5 and 6 acres do not match the proposed area.

mcqs.question: What are the proposed cost and operational timeline of TTD’s Sacred Herbal Garden in Tirumala?
options: ₹3.25 crore and operational by mid-2026
₹4.25 crore and operational by the end of 2026
₹4.25 crore and operational by the end of 2025
₹5.25 crore and operational by the end of 2026
mcqs.explanation: The Sacred Herbal Garden is estimated to cost ₹4.25 crore and is expected to become operational by the end of 2026. The closest trap is the same cost with an earlier completion timeline, but the stated timeline is the end of 2026.

mcqs.question: The proposed TTD Sacred Herbal Garden in Tirumala will be designed with how many thematic zones?
mcqs.explanation: The garden will have 13 thematic zones covering aspects such as health, spiritual traditions and ecology. The other numbers do not represent the proposed design.

mcqs.question: In which year was the Seshachalam Biosphere Reserve notified?
mcqs.explanation: The Seshachalam Biosphere Reserve was notified in 2010. The adjacent years 2008, 2009 and 2011 are incorrect.

mcqs.question:
Match the features associated with the 2026 AP Legislature Biodiversity Calendar:

List-I
 a. Species represented
 b. Legal protection status
 c. Artistic treatment
 d. Committee chairperson

List-II
 i. Kalamkari style enhanced with AI
 ii. Committee chaired by the Speaker
 iii. 12 iconic wild animal species
 iv. Schedule I of the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972

Select the correct code.
options: a-iii, b-iv, c-i, d-ii
a-iv, b-iii, c-ii, d-i
a-iii, b-i, c-iv, d-ii
a-ii, b-iv, c-i, d-iii
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-iii, b-iv, c-i and d-ii: the calendar depicts 12 iconic wild animal species, all in Schedule I, uses Kalamkari enhanced with AI, and is associated with a committee chaired by the Speaker. The other codes interchange these content, legal, artistic and institutional details.

mcqs.question: With reference to the Committee on Wildlife and Environmental Protection of the Andhra Pradesh Legislature, identify the incorrect statement.
options: It is a committee of the AP Legislature.
It deals with wildlife and environmental protection.
It is chaired by the Speaker.
It is chaired by the Chief Minister.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that the committee is chaired by the Chief Minister; it is chaired by the Speaker. The other statements correctly describe the committee and its subject area.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): The Bharatiya Vigyan Sammelan in Tirupati was held from 26–29 December 2025.
Reason (R): The conclave’s participants were the science book fair, exhibitions and student outreach.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Assertion A is true because the Bharatiya Vigyan Sammelan was held from 26–29 December 2025. Reason R is false because ISRO and DRDO were participants, while the science book fair, exhibitions and student outreach were associated activities.
